basic_info.description: Welcome to 3736 Broderick Street, an exquisite four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath Marina residence that embodies the grace and sophistication of classic San Francisco living.  Spanning approximately 2,960 square feet, this beautifully maintained condo showcases stunning San Francisco Marina and Golden Gate Bridge views, exquisite period moldings, coved ceilings, and rich hardwood floors that capture the charm of its era. A sun-filled living room with a stately fireplace frames postcard-perfect vistas, while the formal dining room and kitchen offer seamless flow for entertaining. The spacious bedrooms and bathrooms feature thoughtful details and abundant natural light. Enjoy direct access to a private backyard, ideal for morning coffee or weekend gatherings. Additional highlights include two fireplaces, tandem parking, ample storage, and in-unit laundry. Situated on one of the Marinas most desirable blocks, this home offers easy access to Crissy Field, the Palace of Fine Arts, Marina Green, Chestnut Street dining, and Presidio trails. The best of San Francisco living at your doorstep. You don't want to miss this!
